import nanosurf

# Load the AFM application (choose the appropriate class for your instrument)
spm = nanosurf.SPM()          # e.g., .C3000(), .CX(), or .CoreAFM()

# Access relevant modules
scan = application.Scan
zcontrol = application.ZController

# ---- Scan parameters ----

# (Other scan settings are left unchanged)
